question:
The bar graph given below shows the saving and expenditure of 5 companies J, K, L, M and N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66b6766cb622842c496463cdca99dc1f32416b2c35c275e72052c135bf85ce67.png] 

The average savings of all companies is what percent of the average expenditure of all companies?
solution:
Calculation:

The average expenditure of all companies = (200 + 800 + 600 + 400 + 2000) ÷ 5 = 800

The average savings of all companies = (600 + 1600 + 1200 + 600 + 800) ÷ 5 = 960

Now, the required % = frac {960}{800} times 100\% = 120%

**∴ The average savings of all companies is 120% of the average expenditure of all companies.**
